title: DigiTrack
description: Resource pack that change the Vanilla MC BGM into the Digimon OST.
body:
This is a Resource Pack that is made to change the Minecraft Vanilla BGM into > Digimon OST, to any ya'll Digimon Lover this the pack for you to enjoy vanilla minecraft while also listening to Digimon OST.

- Also Feel free to give me feedback on any suggestions and bug reports, i'm all ears although i may be replying you guys late lmao.

- btw this is my 1st resourcepack that i made so i hope ya'll enjoy it
